content: Kina atte morom fu
Kinaat markoh ɓo' in, mbaa ɗu heyɗi markohse in.
Laam findi ɗu na atte'ohe, Kooh atte'ohan ɗu ɗaa te ɓeesohaani ɗu na ɓeesɗohohe, weɗ ɗu ɓeesɗohsan.
Wa ye tah fu markee ɓoli ŋ hasiŋ morom fu, te wa ndooɗ yakak nik ŋ hasiŋ ɗa ?
Wala fu min na woyoh morom fu ne : “ Faɗa ŋ nihsiɗ ɗa ɓoli ŋ hasiŋ ɗa ”, te ndooɗi yakki weɗɗi ŋ hasiŋ ɗa ?
Naafeehaani, koca nihis ndooɗi yakki nik ŋ hasiŋ ɗa. Fu min hot baahiɗ ne fu nihsiɗ morom fu ɓoli nik ŋ hasiŋ ɗe.
Kinaat eɗ ɓuu ci in ci hoolɗu wuu Kooh bala ca wiirkan nga ɗu, ca faarsoh ɗu, te kinaat njaf per ciŋ ɗu ŋ kot ciŋ mbaam-huk ci bala ca daksohan ca.
Kiimaat, waakaat, laɓɗaat
Kiimaat, ɗu hey onse ; waakaat, ɗu hey hote ; laɓɗaat, ɗu hey rangsiɗasse.
Laam ɓo' nu kiim ɗah, a hey onse, ɓo' nu waak ɗah, a hey hote, te ɓo' nu laɓiɗ ɗah, a hey rangsiɗasse.
Ya ɓa nga ɗu a yi kuɓkiŋ ɗe kiiman ɗe mbuuru, a on ɗe atoh ?
Wala a kiim ɗe cuurund, a on ɗe iiñ ?
Nik ne ɗu ɓi baahaaɗiici, e ɗu min on kuɓuuciŋ ɗu in baahiɗ ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa Baabiŋ ɗu yi ŋ Eel ci, a onanɗi in baahiɗ ɓi na kiimee ɗe wa e ?
Kon, in ci ɗu waaɗ ne ɓooɓi haɓɗiɗ ɗu ca jen, tumɗaat ɓa ca. Ineem weɗ waasiŋMusaa nakoh na woosuuɗ ci.
Yahndeer ci kanak ci
Aasohaat yahndeeri ɓengiɗi laam yahndeeri angiɗi na ɓayohe ŋ boom te waasiŋ wa yooɓpa ; laayiɗ na aasohe nga.
Waaye yahndeeri na ɓayohe ŋ kipes ki, wa ɓengiɗ, waasiŋ wa sewwa te ɓi hota laayɗi.
Ɓi na kulɓa'kohe woosuuɗ
Wortukaat ɓooɓi na tume haf ɓa woosuuɗ, ŋ ɗooƴiŋ ɓa, ɓa ɓaakoɓ saahiɗ. Waaye ɓa haye nga ɗu ɗah, ɓa na haye soosiɗ findi mbaal.
Ɗu na hee ɓa inhisohe in ci pesohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa na rime. Reseñ miniɗ ɓeenohu ŋ ñaaɓaaɓ e ? Wala ndun miniɗ ɓeenohu ŋ ñalkook ?
Kidig nu baah ɗah, wa na raake rim baahiɗ. Waaye kidig nu baahɗi ɗah, na raake rim baahaaɗi.
Kidig baahiɗ minɗi raak rim baahaaɗi te kidig baahaaɗi minɗi raak rim baahiɗ.
Kidig nu raakɗi rim baahiɗ ɗah, wa na ƴoɓse ƴoɓu, wa njafu ŋ yongkaah.
Mbaa ɗu na hee ɓa inhisohe in ci pesohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa na rime.
Woo na tum
E ɓooɓi na ɓeeɗkohee so : “ Heɗ ɓoo, Heɗ ɓoo ” jen ɓeɗ na hee aase ŋ Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki haa, waaye a ɓi na haɓɗe waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Baabiŋ ngo yi nik ŋ Eel ci.
Ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ hey yo woye mbaɗi ne : “ Heɗ ɓoo Heɗ ɓoo, ɓoo meeɗ yegɗoh woo kiŋ Kooh ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa haa e ? Ɓoo aañiɗ jiiniici ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa te ɓoo haɓɗiɗ keemaan laayiɗ ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa. ”
Ŋ ineem, ŋ hey ɓa woye ne : “ Ŋ moosɗi ɗu inhoh, usaat to ɗu ɓi na haɓɗe ini lahɗi waas. ”
Kahan ci kanak ci
Weɗ tah ɓoyi na sikɗuke woo kiŋ ngo wii, a pesohee wa, a mandan na ƴaar ñaañiɗ yi taɓah kahan ce ŋ ɗafuk atoh ;
toɓi keennda, huluɓ ci nupɗeeɗa, puuɗsi puuɗseeɗa, ca tapukka kahneem, waaye wa keenɗi sagu ini wa taɓahu ŋ ɗafuk atoh.
Waaye ɓoyi na sikɗuke woo kiŋ ngo te a pesohuu wa, a mandan na ƴaar naandiɗ yi taɓah kahan ce ŋ ɗafuk beeñ ;
toɓi keennda, huluɓ ci nupɗeeɗa, puuɗsi puuɗseeɗa, ca tapukka kahneem, wa keennda, wa yahrukohha jameet. »
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo woo ceem, mboolnda jen feyuusa ŋ jangɗohiŋ ɗe.
Jangɗohaaɗaŋ ɗe ɗaloheen na findi jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na tumohe, laam a woyee keeh-keeh findi kilifa.
